title: RBI Monetary Policy Statement 2026-27 (62nd MPC Meeting Highlights)
summary: The MPC balances inflation control with economic growth momentum, setting benchmark interest rates for FY27.

blocks.content: The MPC balances inflation control with economic growth momentum, setting benchmark interest rates for FY27.

items:
📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
MPC held 62nd meeting from August 3 to 5, 2026.
Chairmanship: **Sanjay Malhotra** (RBI Governor).
**Repo Rate:** Kept unchanged at **5.25%**.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**Real GDP Growth Projection (FY 2026-27):** Projected at **6.7%** (Q1 7.0%, Q2 6.4%, Q3 6.5%, Q4 6.8%).
**CPI Inflation Projection (FY 2026-27):** Lowered to **5.0%** (earlier 5.1%) (Q2 4.7%, Q3 5.9%, Q4 5.5%). Core inflation projected at **4.3%**.
Macro Buffers: Gross FDI inflows at **US$ 30.7 billion** in Q1 FY27; Forex reserves import cover **over 10 months**.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Real GDP Growth projection (6.7%) vs CPI Inflation projection (5.0%) for FY27.

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "What factors guided the MPC's decision to hold repo rate at 5.25%?"
💡 **Model Answer: Core inflation moderation and robust FDI buffers allowed the MPC to maintain a neutral stance while supporting 6.7% GDP growth.**
